name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: spawns dsh web and hosts it in a standalone window with tray residency
author: DeepSeek Harness

scripts.deploy:closure: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('deploy',{recursive:true,force:true})" && pnpm --filter dsh-desktop-closure deploy --prod --config.node-linker=hoisted --config.inject-workspace-packages=true --config.allow-unused-patches=true --config.strict-dep-builds=false deploy && node -e "for (const f of ['pnpm-lock.yaml','pnpm-workspace.yaml']) require('node:fs').rmSync('deploy/'+f,{force:true})"
scripts.dist: pnpm -w run build:lib && pnpm -w run build:web && pnpm run deploy:closure && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm -w run build:lib && pnpm -w run build:web && pnpm run deploy:closure && pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
